title: Make five sample products before asking for orders

content_json.title: Make five sample products before asking for orders
content_json.what_it_means: People should see real examples before they trust a new business.
what_to_do: Create five sample products in different styles.
Record close-up videos while making them.
Use the samples in your first Instagram posts and WhatsApp status.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can make five sample {{product}} for birthdays, farewell gifts, best friends, couples, and college events in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: People understand what you sell faster when they see real products instead of plain posters.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if people reply asking for price, preview, or delivery after seeing the samples.

title: Start with three actions, not a huge plan

content_json.title: Start with three actions, not a huge plan
content_json.what_it_means: A new business needs a few clear first moves, not too many tasks.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: We are opening soon in {{location}}. Send your idea on WhatsApp, see a preview, and confirm before we make it.
content_json.why_this_helps: Simple first actions help you move today instead of waiting for a perfect launch.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if at least five people ask what you are launching or how to order.
